name: Quote Cinema
description: A quiet cinematic quote card: deep warm black, a slow drifting light leak, heavy film grain and a slow push-in, with a quote that sets word by word in a large serif, one key word in warm italic, and a tracked author line. The frame breathes: the light leak drifts across, the camera pushes in slowly, and the quote fades up one word at a time in rhythm with the reading. The key word turns warm italic, the author line slides in, and a soft 'save this' note closes it.
best_use_cases: Sharing a favourite quote as a cinematic card
style: Quiet cinematic quote card on deep warm black; slow drifting light leak; heavy film grain and slow push-in; quote sets word by word in large serif with one key word in warm italic; tracked author line.
